_about: 1-Butanol (1) + Water (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 101.3 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-butanol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: E. Lladosa, J. B. Monton, M. C. Burguet, R. Munoz, Phase Equilibrium for the Esterification Reaction of Acetic Acid + Butan-1-ol at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 53 (2008) 108-115
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 12, 13. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.28 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).

records.citation: E. Lladosa, J. B. Monton, M. C. Burguet, R. Munoz, Phase Equilibrium for the Esterification Reaction of Acetic Acid + Butan-1-ol at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 53 (2008) 108-115

V. Gomis, A. Font, M. D. Saquete, J. Garcia-Cano, Isothermal (liquid + liquid) equilibrium data at T = 313.15 K and isobaric (vapor + liquid + liquid) equilibrium data at 101.3 kPa for the ternary system (water + 1-butanol + p-xylene), J. Chem. Thermodyn. 79 (2014) 242-247

two_liquids.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
two_liquids.notes: The two liquids in equilibrium, as stored in the records (mole fraction of component 1 in each; record: the index in records). P is the three-phase or the stated pressure where the record gives one. Fitted as liquid-liquid equilibrium (fit_parameters.py); rows of the curve strictly between the two liquids at the same temperature are not fitted as one liquid. To be checked by a person against the records (AGENTS.md rule 4).
